notes.title: PC Playability Update
notes.notes:
In its first major update, Nomad Station is now accessible to players without a VR headset! VR players now have the option to start the game with or without their headset. Simply launch the game and it will detect if there is a headset connected and the input will be adjusted automatically.

[h3]Included in this update:[/h3]
[list]
[*]PC compatibility implemented
[*]Ammo count displays now in more convenient location
[*]Added option to turn-off sitting height detection
[*]Squashed these bugs:
-Grenades occasionally pass through walls when thrown
-Weapon belt moves around too much when trying to laser-grab a weapon from it
-Other minor pesky bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Release Date July 15th
notes.notes:
Get ready to jump into the action and prevent a rising threat from making early gains in a surprise military invasion of the Moon! The seizure of Nomad Station threatens the safety of all colonists in the Hadley-Apennine region! You will be a lone agent up against an army. Even in space, It will not be a quiet mission.

[h3]Updated Trailer[/h3]

 [/h1]

[h3]From the Developer[/h3]
It has been such a journey creating this game. After a year and a half of development, I am excited to finally release it. As a 3D artist, Nomad Station has been the greatest learning experience. Aside from modeling almost everything myself, I was able to learn what it is like to be a programmer, voice actor, sfx editor, writer, and briefly a content promotor all in one project! They are not easy jobs, but I also now have an idea how rewarding they can be for those with the skill to be them full time! One of the biggest takeaways for me as a visual artist is a new profound appreciation for the talented folks that bring games to life through the nuts and bolts, and not just the visuals.

I hope you enjoy playing Nomad Station as much as I enjoyed making it!

-Derek Moritz
